title: Hydraulic 4-Roll Plate Rollers, 2 to 20 ft | NovoTech
meta_description: Hydraulic 4-roll plate rolling machines from 2.1 to 20 ft and plate up to 3-3/8″, with NC / CNC control, cone rolls and automation. CSA panels, parts in Mississauga, ON.
intro: Four-roll plate rolling machines pinch the sheet between the top and bottom roll and bend it with two side rolls, so the plate is pre-bent at both ends and rolled into a full cylinder in one pass without flipping it. Two Turkish makers cover the whole range: ISITAN's 4R HMS hydraulic plate rollers run from a 2.1 ft bench-size roll to 10.2 ft machines for 3/8″ plate, with NC control, overhead crane and sheet feeder for production work, and the 4R OM and 4R HOM roll corrugated galvanized sheet; The 4R HS-L, 4R HS and heavy-duty 4R HSS go on to 20 ft and 3-3/8″ plate for wind towers, vessels and shipyards, with the NC cassette-type 4RH and the 4R HC cone roll beside them. Every 4 roll plate roller is sold with a CSA-approved panel and supported from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: 3-roll or 4-roll plate roller — which one do I need?
faq.a: A 4-roll machine holds the sheet pinched between the top and bottom roll while the side rolls pre-bend and roll it, so both ends are pre-bent without turning the plate around and the operator never loses alignment — the better choice for production, thin or polished material and cones. A 3-roll initial-pinch machine does the same job with one more handling step at a lower price, which is why most job shops start with an MRM-H or MRM-S.

faq.q: What does "capacity at 1.5× / 5× top roll Ø" mean?
faq.a: Plate rolls are rated for a given diameter: the thicker the plate, the larger the minimum cylinder it can form. The manufacturer states two figures — the thickness the machine rolls into a tight cylinder of 1.5 times the top roll diameter, and the thickness it rolls at 5 times the top roll diameter. Tell us your plate thickness and the smallest diameter you make and we will size the machine from the capacity chart.

Yes — a cone-bending device is standard on every 4R HMS, and the NC control stores the roll positions for repeat cones. Hydraulic side supports and the overhead crane keep large cones and thin material in shape while rolling.

faq.q: How automatic can a plate roller be?
faq.a: With the NC control the operator programs the roll positions once; the machine then bends to the stored program. Adding the vacuum sheet feeder, the hydraulic overhead crane and the part ejector turns the 4R HMS into a full automation line where the operator only loads blanks and removes finished cylinders at the welding station.

faq.q: What voltage do ISITAN plate rollers run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor.
